-84.34050,39.25130.name: Bethesda Fertility Center
-84.34050,39.25130.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Isela M. Robertshaw, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

11.96607,48.04538.name: Nuvisan GmbH Betriebsstätte Grafing
11.96607,48.04538.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Nuvisan GmbH. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-0.08872,51.46888.name: King’s Fertility
-0.08872,51.46888.state: Fetal Medicine Research Institute, 1st Floor, 16-20 Windsor Walk, Denmark Hill, London, SE5 8BB, United Kingdom
-0.08872,51.46888.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-47.06528,-22.88770.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: https://www.fivmed.com.br/. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-0.63630,51.27970.name: The Pirbright Institute
-0.63630,51.27970.state: Ash Road, Pirbright, Woking, GU24 0NF, United Kingdom
-0.63630,51.27970.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by The Pirbright Institute. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-96.72000,17.07000.name: Transgenes in Mexican maize landraces
-96.72000,17.07000.desc: Engineered sequences found in maize landraces in Oaxaca, the crop's centre of origin. This is not cross-breeding into a crop but into the reservoir every commercial maize variety on Earth was ultimately bred from, and Mexico has had to defend its restrictions against a US trade challenge since.

12.48850,41.88850.name: FAO agroecology programme
12.48850,41.88850.state: Rome — FAO, Viale delle Terme di Caracalla
12.48850,41.88850.desc: The UN food agency’s work on farming systems built around biological processes rather than purchased inputs. Its relevance here is narrow and real: most engineered traits exist to make an input work better, so a system that uses fewer inputs has less use for them. It is the only body at that level treating this as an agronomic question rather than a regulatory one.
